notes: Original benchmark files and checkpoint-bound implementation remain unchanged.

Short control conditions observe target cases only; their times are not new baseline or speedup estimates.
Host spans are asynchronous dispatch/wait durations, not isolated GPU kernel durations.

A CPU-proven recursive fingerprint reference cycle is a lead; original GPU spike attribution remains unconfirmed.
